title: A browser for your agents
summary: Agents can use a real Chrome browser with your approval, and Matrix gets customizable themes.

highlights.title: A browser your agents can use
highlights.body: Your agents can browse in a Chrome window on your Matrix computer. You can watch it, and in Supervised mode every action waits for your approval, with Undo.

highlights.title: Custom themes
highlights.body: Pick a Matrix theme or make your own. Badges and icons stay readable whatever you choose.

items.text: A getting-started checklist opens each task in its own chat.
Try Matrix with a 14-day Starter trial.
Review Gmail drafts before they're sent.
Connected apps can take actions you explicitly allow.
Dictate messages on mobile.
The mobile terminal has the keys coding agents need.
The mobile app moves more smoothly, with haptics, toasts and long-press menus.
On mobile, a project's chats open above the project.
The mobile app recovers when a chat fails to load, send or run.
The matrix CLI can update itself.
Imported conversations are labeled and can be filtered, and you can import several at once.
Long Claude runs keep going past 30 minutes.
Supervised mode offers an approval instead of a dead-end denial.
Managed Pi shows command details and tool progress.
Terminal output comes back after you reattach.
Attachments, commands and bot status work again in Chat.
Signing in to Codex and Claude from Settings works again.
The mobile composer stays above the Android keyboard.
The mobile side panel stays shut when you swipe left.
Mobile Settings includes Connect Apps, and side panel titles fit.
Getting-started panels no longer overlap.
Sharing is hidden on mobile for individual accounts.
